Are you lacking confidence in discussing course topics in English with your classmates?

Do you wish to effortlessly grasp the key points and interact in an English-taught classroom?

Come join our English for Specific Purposes Lunch Gathering!

We will cover various topics, including business, history, science, and technology, guided by international students. You'll gain insights into the issues and key vocabulary, while also practicing group discussions and presentations!

Registration is free, but seats are limited.

Register now!

We're excited to announce three upcoming gatherings. Mark your calendars and join us for these enriching discussions:

▲Session 1: 3/26

Topic: Why Do We Buy? Exploring Consumer Behavior
為什麼我們會購買？ 探索消費者行為

Date: March 26

Time: 12:10 PM - 1:00 PM

Description: Ever wondered why you buy certain products and not others? This activity uncovers the secrets of consumer behavior through a fun, interactive game that puts you in the mind of both the shopper and the marketer!
